senses.gloss: m. (סָלַל II; cmp. סוּלָּם) path, gutter, in gen. duct, pipe, tube.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:1">Kil. VII, 1</cite> <he>הבריכה בדלעת או בס׳</he> if in sinking a vine he conducted it through gourd shells or through a pipe (so that it could draw no nourishment from the ground which it passed); Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 7:1:4">Y. Kil. VII, beg. 30ᵈ</cite> <he>ס׳ של חרס</he> an earthen pipe; <he>ס׳ של אבר</he> a leaden pipe.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:4">Sabb. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 38b:11">38ᵇ</cite>) <he>הכיאו סל׳ של צונן וכ׳</he> (Y. a. Bab. ed. <cite ref="O01010"><he>סיל׳</he></cite>) they passed a duct of cold water through an arm of the hot springs.
<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 2:2">Tosef. Makhsh. II, 2</cite> <he>ס׳ של יוצר</he> an earthen water pipe.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:10">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ס׳ החוזר</he> the urin in the urinary duct which is forced back.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:22">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>כמין ס׳ של אש</he> like a duct of fire; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 99b:4">B. Bath. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>בית הס׳</he> comment., v. <cite ref="S00964"><he>קִילוֹן</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>סִילּוֹנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:3">Kel. II, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 2:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 3</cite>. Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 18 <he>ס׳ שבכרכין</he> the culverts in large cities; Y. ib. VIII, end, 25ᵇ.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>הם קלקלו ס׳ שלהן וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="O00661"><he>סילונית</he></cite>) they abused their (seminal) ducts, therefore the Lord changed the order (of irrigation) of the world.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 5:4">Pirké d’R. El. ch. V</cite> <he>ס׳ עולין וכ׳</he> (not … <he>נית</he>) ducts rise from the depth to irrigate &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 20:6">Yalk. Gen. 20</cite> (corr. acc.).
